what: Hovering a work card covers the image with a frosted glass layer (blur 14px) over .8s, and a small image (60% width) in its center opens from the left edge to the right over .8s (clip). The feature tag row below rises from 1em below over .3s, the description text underneath slides 1em up and fades out, and the category tag rises in its place. The background image very slowly zooms in to 1.05x over 5s and returns over 1.2s when the hover ends — all curves cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). Shop·case list card

options.look: light: Make the glass film light (background color 50%) — default is a dark film (--kf-ink-soft 50%)
